vi_context: Nếu mua online, thói quen phân biệt số đo cơ thể và số đo sản phẩm trong đọc số đo khi mua rất hữu ích. sentence: A silver bracelet's wearing construction can help compare shapes, while the titanium model's own measurements still need confirming.
en_before: Wrap a soft tape measure around your wrist where you plan to wear the bracelet. Keep it snug without tightening it. Consult the model’s sizing instructions, since rigid bangles, flexible bracelets, and clasped designs fit differently. The amount of extra room depends on the construction.
en_after: Wrap a soft tape measure around your wrist where you plan to wear the bracelet. A silver bracelet's wearing construction can help compare shapes, while the titanium model's own measurements still need confirming. Keep it snug without tightening it. Consult the model’s sizing instructions, since rigid bangles, flexible bracelets, and clasped designs fit differently. The amount of extra room depends on the construction.
